name: Matty B Stackers Live Rosin Disposable | Prodigy
description:
.5g Rosin Disposable
If you're on the hunt for a hard-hitting and heavy sativa to really help you get energized and get to work, Prodigy is totally made for you. This heavy hitter packs a rushing high that will instantly have you feeling lifted and motivated. Almost as soon as you exhale, you'll be filled with a sense of almost frenzied cerebral energy that activates the senses and gets your creative juices flowing. You'll find focus comes easy along with a sense of motivation that works well in helping you get focused and on task. These effects can build without a ceiling, so mind your dosage if you ever experience paranoia or anxiety with sativas.
